newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila call loan rate slips in sideways market.
newsitem.headline: Manila call loan rate slips in sideways market.

text.p: * Helped by peso liquidity from the Central Bank
Philippine interbank call loan rates slipped on Thursday after three days of gains to an average of 12.3125 percent from 12.46875, dealers said.
"The market is slightly easing but it's still generally tight.

The dollar purchases by the Central Bank helped to liquify the market," a foreign bank dealer said, adding that this effectively released pesos from the Central Bank in exchange for the dollars it bought.
The Bureau of Treasury had said it will cut by 500 million peso each the weekly volume of 182-day bills which would be at 1.5 billion pesos and the 364-day bills which would be at 2.0 billion pesos.
